sections.section_title: Authority Over a Legion of Unclean Spirits in Gentile Territory
sections.summary: Jesus crosses into Gentile territory and liberates a man possessed by a legion of unclean spirits, sending them into pigs that rush into the sea; the townspeople beg Jesus to leave while the healed man is commissioned to proclaim what the Lord has done.

sections.section_title: Jairus and the Urgency of Faith
sections.summary: A synagogue official named Jairus falls at Jesus's feet and begs him to come heal his dying twelve-year-old daughter.

sections.section_title: The Woman with the Flow of Blood
sections.summary: A woman who has hemorrhaged for twelve years touches Jesus's garment in faith and is healed; Jesus identifies her faith as the cause of her restoration, calls her 'daughter,' and sends her in peace.

After Jairus's daughter dies during the delay, Jesus commands the father to keep believing, enters the room with three disciples, takes the dead girl by the hand, and raises her with the Aramaic command 'Talitha kum.'
